newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Soccer fans threaten to strip players naked.
newsitem.headline: Soccer fans threaten to strip players naked.

text.p: A Romanian junior team, trailing their opponents 16-0, fled from the field two minutes before time on Sunday after fans threatened to strip them naked if they conceded two more goals.
"With the score 16-0 for the opposing team, some gypsy fans shouted Atletic Bucharest would leave the stadium naked if they lost the game 18-0," the daily newspaper Evenimentul Zilei reported.
The club have been fined 50 million lei ($14,500) by the Romanian soccer federation.
"We're very sorry for Atletic but we had to apply the rules which are the same for everybody," a federation spokesman said.
